COMMITTEE ON AGING 4 I’m really proud to be here today as this Committee votes on my bill, Introduction 25-A, which was introduced last term. As the Chair said, aging in place with dignity is a critical value that we live by and act by in this Council. This bill will require HPD to provide eligible New Yorkers living in Mitchell-Lama apartment buildings with prefilled SCRIE applications. Affordable housing and support for older adults are two causes of significant value, both to myself and my District. The SCRIE program is crucial to supporting both, but it is not being utilized as much as it could. Our City agencies have access to the information that deems a Mitchell-Lama resident eligible for the SCRIE program. Why sit around and wait for our older adults to apply when we can take a proactive approach now? We must make a greater effort to understand the needs of the aging population and support their well-being. No person should be forced out of their home while in retirement due to a lack of affordability, and this bill brings us one step closer to eliminating this in New York City.
